received_works.body:
Dear JuBaKo

Hello, my name is Leo Takasumi and I am a VTuber.
I am a VTuber and I would like to send a request for JuBaKo's illustrations because I love the expressions and coloring in your illustrations.
I would like to summarize my request as follows.

Contents
I would like to have Leo Takasumi.
I would like to see a belligerent face with a slightly dark atmosphere.
The pose and composition are up to you.
We would like to use it as a thumbnail, etc., so we would appreciate it if the face and body area is not cut off.


Reference materials

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-4Mcz_ZZLIb8zHYai5_gMPeTm5CFOE3s

Background
Please leave this to us.
We would appreciate it if you could provide us with a transparent background.

Usage
I will use it for game distribution, thumbnails, and icons.

We apologize for the inconvenience, but we would appreciate it if you would consider our proposal.
Thank you in advance.

Hey! Absolutely love your Art style!

I would love to commission a 16:9  illustration artwork from you in your art style of my OC Demon Vtuber Barragans 2.0!

I would like to intrust you with most of the ideas for the concept and below I have provided some refs for ideas. you can go in either direction of more action or peaceful.

1.) Surrounded by purple and cyan flames in a elegant like martial art stance (similar to your most recent art you posted)

2.) Similar to 1 but instead of flames have it be purple petals of flowers swirling around him (this can be in a fighting stance or peaceful pose up to you!) and it be more ethereal/elegant

3.) Other ideas posted in folder

The expression/pose/composition I will leave up to you. Barragan typically has a more of a serious stoic personality but is also very kind hearted with a warm smile when happy.

As for the background I'll also leave this completely up to you again as I trust your art! 

If possible if I could have the art seperated into different layers too for potential animation that would be amazing but if not thats okay!

Thank you so much for taking time to read and consider my request! Sorry for the resend I provided the wrong refs :')
